name: Roommates' Apartment
text: If you and your partner each take at least your own bid, gain +30 contract value.

signature.trigger: you and your partner both make your bids

decision: Sharing tricks: when one partner is short, the other feeds them rather than overtaking.
opponent: Visible at scoring; opponents answer by setting the partner who is short.
aiNote: When your partner is short of their bid and you have made yours, let their winners stand.
rationale: Both partners make positive bids and take them in about half of rounds, so about +15 a round; a nil from either partner turns it off, and it differs from Attentive Ear (BL-U06), which needs your partner exact.
deviation: Revision 1: replaced shared-resonance counting with a plain partnership condition.
